profiles.name: Microsoft Entra identity
profiles.description: Microsoft identity-platform authorization and token endpoints.
profiles.reason: Blocking this identity endpoint can prevent Microsoft account or work/school account authentication and token exchange.

profiles.name: Google OAuth
profiles.description: Google OAuth authorization, token, and token-revocation endpoints.
profiles.reason: Blocking this endpoint can prevent Google sign-in, consent, token exchange, token refresh, or revocation flows.

profiles.name: Sign in with Apple
profiles.description: Apple ID authorization endpoint used by Sign in with Apple.
profiles.reason: Blocking this endpoint can prevent Sign in with Apple authorization flows.

profiles.name: Mozilla account and Firefox Sync
profiles.description: Mozilla account sign-in endpoint used to enable Firefox Sync.
profiles.reason: Blocking this endpoint can prevent Mozilla account sign-in and Firefox Sync setup.

profiles.name: Windows network connectivity detection
profiles.description: Windows NCSI active DNS and HTTP connectivity probes.
profiles.reason: Blocking these probes can make Windows report limited or no Internet connectivity and can interfere with captive-portal detection.
